changelog: **Profile completeness meter on the mentee portal** (light gamification). `/portal` used to show a yellow "complete your profile" box whenever `university` or `skills` was empty, linking to the onboarding wizard. It is replaced by a real meter: `src/lib/profileCompleteness.ts` (dependency-free, unit-tested in `scripts/test/profile-completeness.test.mjs`, `npm run test:profile-completeness`) weighs the nine fields that matching, the AI ranking, the talent pool and the public profile actually read (skills 25, target position 15, CV 15, university 10, department 10, interests 10, city 5, graduation year 5, bio 5 — sum 100) and returns the percentage plus the empty fields, heaviest first. `ProfileProgressMeter` renders it as a `role="progressbar"` with the percentage and a checklist whose items deep-link to the field (`/portal/profile#profile-field-<key>`); the card disappears at 100% on `/portal` and collapses to one line on `/portal/profile`, where the same meter sits at the top and follows the saved profile (load, save, CV upload/removal). No points, badges, streaks or comparisons, and nothing that rewards logging activity (the billing meter counts relations with activity). Internship only: both pages live behind the portal layout's `mentorship` capability gate. Covered by `e2e/profile-progress.spec.ts` (numbers, anchors, live update, 100%, dark-mode contrast, 360px width, MARKETING redirect).

en: Your portal now shows how complete your profile is, with a short list of the fields that are still empty — each one takes you straight to the field. The fuller your profile, the more matching and the people reviewing it have to work with.
tr: Portalın artık profilinin ne kadar dolu olduğunu ve hâlâ boş olan alanların kısa bir listesini gösteriyor — her madde seni doğrudan o alana götürür. Profilin ne kadar doluysa eşleştirme ve profilini inceleyenler o kadar çok bilgiyle çalışır.
de: Dein Portal zeigt jetzt, wie vollständig dein Profil ist, mit einer kurzen Liste der noch leeren Felder — jeder Eintrag führt dich direkt zum Feld. Je vollständiger dein Profil, desto mehr haben das Matching und alle, die es ansehen, in der Hand.
